column1: Sector ID (abbccdd, a = challenge, b = difficulty, c = area, d = sector/rotation)
column3: Status of sector (1 = Permalocked, 2 = Unlocks after time, 3 = Starts unlocked)
column4: If Unlock Type is 2, time (in seconds) relative to the start of the season/week
column5: Number of segments for players to battle
column7: Number of segments to unlock and sector skill that it unlocks
column12: Whether it is a boss battle or not
column18: Skill ID active for all battles in this sector
